summary: Pure visual capture task for AI Strategist Auto-Optimize feature in /forecast. Logged in as ceo@controlroom.it, opened the AI Strategist modal via data-testid='open-ai-strategist', captured the form state, filled inputs (target=1.5M, horizon=5, max_ltv=60, capitale=300k, strategia=mista, propensione=media, vincoli=Preferenza Milano e Bologna, no vendite nei primi 2 anni), clicked 'ai-strategist-generate', waited ~30s for the AI response. Modal transitioned form -> loading -> result and the goal banner appeared. Captured the result state (full_page=True) showing strategy proposed, expected outcome, 10 generated operations, key risks and KPI cards. Closed modal via 'ai-strategist-close' and captured the Forecast page header with the new gradient 'AI Strategist' button + Nuovo/Duplica/PDF/Elimina controls.
